title: Tracing the fate of carbon and the atmospheric evolution of Mars
subject: Ecology
question: According to the 'Mantle Plume Scenario' (solid red line), what was the approximate outgassing rate at 3.0 Ga before present?

gold_answer.long_answer: Following the solid red line (Mantle Plume Scenario) from the x-axis value of 3.0 Ga upwards, the line intersects the y-axis at approximately 0.25 bar Gyr⁻¹.
